name: Salmon noodle wraps
assumptions: Recipe serves 2 based on two parcels and 300g salmon split across them
Total time estimated from instructions: 10 min prep + 15-20 min bake, rounded to 30 min
Rice noodles classified as gluten-free (no wheat, barley, rye)
No dairy, eggs, tree nuts, peanuts, soy, sesame, shellfish or wheat listed
Ingredients like chilli, coriander and lime assumed as listed without sauces or compounds that would introduce ambiguity
Petit pois are green peas, compatible with all listed diets except those already false
No substitutions or unlisted ingredients assumed
instructions:
step 1
Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. Put the noodles in a bowl and pour over enough boiling water to just cover them. Leave for 2 mins, until they are bendable, but not too soft, then drain well. Return to the bowl with the spring onions, petit pois, salt and pepper and a third of the butter. Mix well until the butter has melted.

step 2
Pile the noodles and vegetables onto two large squares of baking parchment, then sit the salmon on top. Slice the remaining butter and arrange over the top of the salmon. Bring the ends of the paper over the fish, fold them together to seal, then tuck the ends of the paper underneath so there are no gaps. Put the parcels on a baking sheet and bake for 15-20 mins. Transfer to dinner plates and serve without delay.

ingredients.name: Rice Noodles
ingredients.assumptions: Standard dry rice noodles; values based on typical uncooked white rice vermicelli.

ingredients.name: Spring Onions
ingredients.assumptions: 3 medium spring onions (scallions) sliced thinly; typical combined edible weight ~45g.

ingredients.name: Petit Pois
ingredients.assumptions: Frozen or fresh petit pois (small green peas); standard nutritional profile for cooked peas adjusted for recipe use.

ingredients.name: Chilli
ingredients.assumptions: One medium fresh red or green chilli (85g whole weight); includes seeds and stem as typical in Vietnamese recipes; values for raw chilli pepper.

ingredients.name: Coriander
ingredients.assumptions: Fresh coriander (cilantro) leaves and stems; 85g is a large bunch, typical values for raw coriander.

ingredients.name: Lime
ingredients.assumptions: One large fresh lime (whole weight ~85g including peel); values represent edible flesh/juice portion scaled to whole weight as recipe lists whole fruit.

ingredients.name: Salmon
ingredients.assumptions: Raw Atlantic salmon fillet; typical farmed salmon values, edible portion only.
